title: Declare exactly one primary artifact as a train's terminal contract

facts.note: Any task that defines, changes or checks a train's terminal artifact or its family, whoever the actor is.
Non-exhaustive discovery hints only. The invariant holds for every train definition wherever it is stored; a train outside these patterns is still in scope.

values: train terminal step or its artifact added/modified
train checked for terminal contract or family
facts.note: Needs a diff-level observer on a train's final step artifacts and family field. Either change alone triggers; they need not occur together.

fires: A new train is defined, including its final step.
The artifacts of an existing train's terminal step are changed, even if the family is untouched.
A train's family (behavior|delivery) is set or changed, even if the terminal step is untouched.
A train definition is reviewed or checked for its terminal contract or family.
doesNotFire: Only intermediate (non-terminal) steps of a train are edited and neither the terminal step nor the family is defined, changed or checked.
Work on wagons, WMBTs, acceptances or docs that does not define, change or check any train.

given: A train exists or is being defined, wherever its definition is stored.
when: The train's terminal step artifact or its family is defined, changed, or checked (either one alone is enough).
then: The train's terminal step declares exactly one primary artifact, which is the train's terminal contract.
prefer: Name one primary artifact on the final step and treat it as the terminal contract: the source of truth for the train's family.

Derive the family from the terminal contract: set family = delivery only if the terminal contract BOTH requires an Acceptance Authority commit AND terminates in platform:acceptance:commit-receipt; in every other case set family = behavior.
Whenever either the terminal artifact or the family changes alone, re-apply the derivation above and make the declared family match its result.
avoid: Declaring zero or several primary artifacts on the terminal step.
Deriving, guessing or asserting the family from the train id (or its name/prefix) — never do this; only the terminal contract decides.
Declaring delivery when only one of the two delivery conditions holds.
why: One declared terminal contract is the single unambiguous source of truth for what a train delivers, so its family is derived from it and never from the train id.
evidence: The train's terminal step lists exactly one primary artifact.

Family is consistent with the terminal contract: delivery iff the contract requires an Acceptance Authority commit and terminates in platform:acceptance:commit-receipt; otherwise behavior — regardless of what the train id suggests.
verifier_detail: Term terminal_contract (label 'Terminal contract'): the declared primary artifact of a train's final step; family (behavior|delivery) is derived from it, never from the train id.

Family mapping: delivery iff (terminal contract requires an Acceptance Authority commit AND terminates in platform:acceptance:commit-receipt); anything else maps to behavior. Both conditions are required.
Scope: every train definition, irrespective of file path or author role; path patterns are discovery hints only.

splitSuggestion.then: Derive a train's family from its terminal contract: delivery if the contract requires an Acceptance Authority commit and terminates in platform:acceptance:commit-receipt, otherwise behavior; never derive or assert the family from the train id.

additions.text: Family derivation (S007/S010) could become its own rule planner.train.family. Until it exists, the full derivation (both delivery conditions, behavior fallback) and the categorical train-id ban are delivered here as operative guidance in prefer[1], avoid[1], avoid[2] and why, and repeated in evidence/verifier_detail.
additions.justification: Rule 2: one obligation in then; auditor required the family decision to be operative coder guidance.

additions.text: Task terms, path globs and change facts are inferred; the source has no activation section. Path globs are non-exhaustive hints.
additions.justification: Activation facts are required by the target schema.

additions.text: Non-firing situations inferred from the rule's scope (terminal step / family only).
Re-apply the family derivation when either the terminal artifact or the family changes independently.
additions.justification: Operationalises the source's 'source of truth' relation for edits touching only one side; adds no obligation beyond the source's derivation.

additions.justification: Restates the source's conjunctive condition as an anti-pattern; no new obligation.
